examples.name: spw_rmap_node
examples.title: SpaceWire RMAP target
examples.description: SpaceWire RMAP target: an OpenWire port and an OpenRMAP target with its memory interface.

examples.name: spp_over_spw
examples.title: Space Packets over SpaceWire
examples.description: Space Packets over SpaceWire: OpenSPP behind the pass-through port of an OpenRMAP target, which shares one OpenWire port.

examples.name: spp_over_spw_two_clocks
examples.title: Space Packets over SpaceWire, two clocks
examples.description: Space Packets over SpaceWire with two clock domains: the SpaceWire side runs on a 50 MHz port clock, the Space Packet node on the 100 MHz system clock. The Composer inserts asynchronous FIFOs for the packet links.

examples.name: encrypted_spp_over_spw
examples.title: Encrypted packets over SpaceWire
examples.description: Encrypted packets over SpaceWire: the OpenCrypto framer cuts every input packet (for example a compressed image) into chunks, the AES-GCM core encrypts every chunk with a generated IV and a 4-byte position in the AAD, and OpenSPP sends every encrypted chunk as one Space Packet through an N-Char adapter and an OpenWire port.
